name: Learning.LinearBandit.inner_sq_le
doc: `⟪x, v⟫ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 ‖v‖ ^ 2` for `x ∈ 𝒳` in the ball of radius `R`.
code:
/-- `⟪x, v⟫ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 ‖v‖ ^ 2` for `x ∈ 𝒳` in the ball of radius `R`. -/
lemma inner_sq_le {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R) (x : 𝒳) (v : E) :
    ⟪(x : E), v⟫ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : |⟪(x : E), v⟫| ≤ R * ‖v‖ :=
    (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hR _ x.2) (norm_nonneg _))
  have h2 : ⟪(x : E), v⟫ ^ 2 ≤ (R * ‖v‖) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sq_abs]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
  rwa [mul_pow] at h2

name: Learning.tsum_ite_lt_eq_sum_range_toNat
doc: A series of terms which vanish unless `t < τ`, for a finite `τ`, is a sum over `t < τ`.

statement.conclusion: (∑' (t : ℕ), if ↑t < τ then f t else 0) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range τ.toNat, f t

code:
/-- A series of terms which vanish unless `t < τ`, for a finite `τ`, is a sum over `t < τ`. -/
lemma tsum_ite_lt_eq_sum_range_toNat {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] [TopologicalSpace β]
    (f : ℕ → β) {τ : ℕ∞} (hτ : τ ≠ ⊤) :
    ∑' t : ℕ, (if (t : ℕ∞) < τ then f t else 0) = ∑ t ∈ range τ.toNat, f t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.1 hτ
  simp_rw [ENat.natCast_lt_natCast, ENat.toNat_natCast]
  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := range k) fun t ht ↦ ite_eq_right (by simpa using ht)]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ ite_eq_left (mem_range.1 ht)

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.klDiv_map_stoppedValue_sigmaHistory_compProd
doc:
**Divergence decomposition for histories stopped at an almost surely finite stopping time**,
composition-product form. For an algorithm `alg` run against two stationary environments with
reward kernels `κ` and `κ'`, and a stopping rule `S` whose stopping time is almost surely finite
under both laws, the divergence between the laws of the stopped histories is the series over the
rounds `t` of the conditional divergences of the reward kernels given the played action, on the
event `{t < τ}`.

binders.name: S
binders.type: Set ((n : ℕ) × Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n)

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (stationaryEnv κ) P

binders.name: h'
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (stationaryEnv κ') P'

binders.name: hτ
binders.type: ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω ≠ ⊤

binders.name: hτ'
binders.type: ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω') ∂P', MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0 ω ≠ ⊤

statement.conclusion:
InformationTheory.klDiv
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
      (MeasureTheory.stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O X Y)
        (MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0))
      P)
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
      (MeasureTheory.stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O' X' Y')
        (MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0))
      P') =
  ∑' (t : ℕ),
    InformationTheory.klDiv
      ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X t)
            (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω})).compProd
        κ)
      ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X t)
            (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω})).compProd
        κ')

code:
/-- **Divergence decomposition for histories stopped at an almost surely finite stopping time**,
composition-product form. For an algorithm `alg` run against two stationary environments with
reward kernels `κ` and `κ'`, and a stopping rule `S` whose stopping time is almost surely finite
under both laws, the divergence between the laws of the stopped histories is the series over the
rounds `t` of the conditional divergences of the reward kernels given the played action, on the
event `{t < τ}`. -/
lemma IsAlgEnvSeq.klDiv_map_stoppedValue_sigmaHistory_compProd
    (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (stationaryEnv κ) P)
    (h' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (stationaryEnv κ') P') (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hτ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω ≠ ⊤)
    (hτ' : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P', hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0 ω ≠ ⊤) :
    klDiv (P.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O X Y) (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0)))
        (P'.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0))) =
      ∑' t : ℕ,
        klDiv ((P.restrict {ω | (t : WithTop ℕ) < hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω}).map
            (X t) ⊗ₘ κ)
          ((P.restrict {ω | (t : WithTop ℕ) < hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω}).map
            (X t) ⊗ₘ κ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.klDiv_map_stoppedValue_sigmaHistory_stepKernel h' hS hτ hτ']
  refine tsum_congr fun t ↦ ?_
  have h_obs := (h.hasCondDistrib_obs_restrict_lt_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hS t).map_eq
  rw [obs_stationaryEnv] at h_obs
  rw [stepKernel_stationaryEnv, stepKernel_stationaryEnv,
    klDiv_compProd_compProd_compProd_prodMkLeft_eq_klDiv_comp_compProd, ← h_obs,
    ← (h.hasCondDistrib_action_restrict_lt_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hS t).hasLaw_comp.map_eq]

name: Learning.klDiv_compProd_compProd_prodMkLeft
doc:
The divergence of one step of a policy/reward decomposition, in integral form: the policy
`π` is shared and the reward kernels `κ`, `η` (which ignore the history) differ, so the
divergence is the expected divergence of the reward kernels at the played action, whose law is
`π ∘ₘ μ`.

statement.conclusion:
InformationTheory.klDiv (μ.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft α κ)))
    (μ.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft α η))) =
  ∫⁻ (b : β), InformationTheory.klDiv (κ b) (η b) ∂μ.bind ⇑π

code:
/-- The divergence of one step of a policy/reward decomposition, in integral form: the policy
`π` is shared and the reward kernels `κ`, `η` (which ignore the history) differ, so the
divergence is the expected divergence of the reward kernels at the played action, whose law is
`π ∘ₘ μ`. -/
lemma klDiv_compProd_compProd_prodMkLeft [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated β γ]
    (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (π : Kernel α β) [IsMarkovKernel π] (κ η : Kernel β γ)
    [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    klDiv (μ ⊗ₘ (π ⊗ₖ Kernel.prodMkLeft α κ)) (μ ⊗ₘ (π ⊗ₖ Kernel.prodMkLeft α η)) =
      ∫⁻ b, klDiv (κ b) (η b) ∂(π ∘ₘ μ)

name: Learning.LinearBandit.klDiv_map_history_of_sq_le
doc:
**Divergence decomposition for linear Gaussian environments**, under a pointwise bound
`⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 ≤ C` on `𝒳`.

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P

binders.name: h'
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ') P'

binders.name: hC
binders.type: ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, inner ℝ x (θ - θ') ^ 2 ≤ C

statement.conclusion:
InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history O X Y n) P)
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history O' X' Y' n) P') =
  ENNReal.ofReal (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ (ω : Ω), inner ℝ (↑(X t ω)) (θ - θ') ^ 2 / 2 ∂P)

code:
/-- **Divergence decomposition for linear Gaussian environments**, under a pointwise bound
`⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 ≤ C` on `𝒳`. -/
lemma klDiv_map_history_of_sq_le (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P)
    (h' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ') P') {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 ≤ C) (n : ℕ) :
    klDiv (P.map (history O X Y n)) (P'.map (history O' X' Y' n)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∑ t ∈ range n, ∫ ω, ⟪(X t ω : E), θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 / 2 ∂P)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (stationaryEnv (linearGaussianKernel 𝒳 θ)) P := h
  have h₁' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (stationaryEnv (linearGaussianKernel 𝒳 θ')) P' := h'
  rw [h₁.klDiv_map_history h₁', ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg
    fun t _ ↦ integral_nonneg fun ω ↦ by positivity]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [klDiv_linearGaussianKernel]
  refine (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ by
    positivity)).symm
  refine Integrable.of_bound ((measurable_inner_action h t (θ - θ')).pow_const 2 |>.div_const 2
    |>.aestronglyMeasurable) (C / 2) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  linarith [hC _ (X t ω).2]

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.klDiv_map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory
doc:
**Divergence decomposition for histories stopped at a bounded stopping time**, integral
form: the divergence between the laws of the histories stopped at `min τ M` is the expected sum,
along the first trajectory, of the divergences of the reward kernels at the actions played before
`min τ M`.

binders.name: S
binders.type: Set ((n : ℕ) × Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n)

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (stationaryEnv κ) P

binders.name: h'

statement.conclusion:
InformationTheory.klDiv
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map

        (MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0) M)
      P)
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
      (MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O' X' Y')
        (MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0) M)
      P') =
  ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (min (MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω) ↑M).toNat,
      InformationTheory.klDiv (κ (X t ω)) (κ' (X t ω)) ∂P

code:
/-- **Divergence decomposition for histories stopped at a bounded stopping time**, integral
form: the divergence between the laws of the histories stopped at `min τ M` is the expected sum,
along the first trajectory, of the divergences of the reward kernels at the actions played before
`min τ M`. -/
lemma IsAlgEnvSeq.klDiv_map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated 𝓨]
    (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (stationaryEnv κ) P)
    (h' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (stationaryEnv κ') P') (hS : MeasurableSet S) (M : ℕ) :
    klDiv (P.map (stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O X Y) (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0) M))
        (P'.map (stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O' X' Y')
          (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0) M)) =
      ∫⁻ ω, ∑ t ∈ range (ENat.toNat (min (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω) M)),
        klDiv (κ (X t ω)) (κ' (X t ω)) ∂P
proof:
:= by
  have hX := h.measurable_action
  have hmeas : ∀ t, Measurable fun ω ↦ klDiv (κ (X t ω)) (κ' (X t ω)) := fun t ↦
    (measurable_klDiv_kernel κ κ').comp (hX t)
  have hlt : ∀ t : ℕ,
      MeasurableSet {ω | (t : WithTop ℕ) < hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω} :=
    measurableSet_lt_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory h.measurable_obs hX h.measurable_feedback hS
  rw [h.klDiv_map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_compProd h' hS M]
  simp_rw [klDiv_compProd_right_eq_lintegral, lintegral_map (measurable_klDiv_kernel κ κ') (hX _),
    ← lintegral_indicator (hlt _)]
  rw [← lintegral_finsetSum _ fun t _ ↦ (hmeas t).indicator (hlt t)]
  refine lintegral_congr fun ω ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact sum_ite_lt_eq_sum_range_toNat_min _ _ M

`⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 / 2`.

code:
/-- The one-step divergence of two linear Gaussian reward kernels at the action `x` is
`⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 / 2`. -/
lemma klDiv_linearGaussianKernel (x : 𝒳) :
    klDiv (linearGaussianKernel 𝒳 θ x) (linearGaussianKernel 𝒳 θ' x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (⟪(x : E), θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  change klDiv (gaussianReal ⟪(x : E), θ⟫ 1) (gaussianReal ⟪(x : E), θ'⟫ 1) = _
  rw [klDiv_gaussianReal_one, inner_sub_right]

lemma klDiv_map_history (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P)

/-- The divergence between the laws of the histories of the first `n` rounds under two linear
Gaussian environments is at most `n R ^ 2 ‖θ - θ'‖ ^ 2 / 2` when `𝒳` lies in the ball of

lemma klDiv_map_history_le (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P)
    (h' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ') P') {R : ℝ} (hR : ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (n : ℕ) :

:=

name: Learning.sum_ite_lt_eq_sum_range_toNat_min
doc: A sum over `t < M` of terms which vanish unless `t < τ` is a sum over `t < min τ M`.

statement.conclusion: (∑ t ∈ Finset.range M, if ↑t < τ then f t else 0) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (min τ ↑M).toNat, f t

code:
/-- A sum over `t < M` of terms which vanish unless `t < τ` is a sum over `t < min τ M`. -/
lemma sum_ite_lt_eq_sum_range_toNat_min {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (f : ℕ → β) (τ : ℕ∞)
    (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ t ∈ range M, (if (t : ℕ∞) < τ then f t else 0) = ∑ t ∈ range (min τ M).toNat, f t
proof:
:= by
  induction τ using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp
  | coe k =>
    rw [← sum_filter]
    congr 1
    ext t
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range, ENat.natCast_lt_natCast]
    rcases le_total k M with hkM | hkM
    · rw [min_eq_left (by exact_mod_cast hkM), ENat.toNat_natCast]
      omega
    · rw [min_eq_right (by exact_mod_cast hkM), ENat.toNat_natCast]
      omega

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.klDiv_map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_stepKernel
doc:
**Chain rule for histories stopped at a bounded stopping time.** For an algorithm `alg` run
against two environments `env`, `env'`, and a stopping rule `S` with stopping time `τ`, the
divergence between the laws of the histories stopped at `min τ M` is the sum over the rounds
`t < M` of the conditional divergences, on the event `{t < τ}`, of the step at round `t` given
the first `t` rounds (composition-product form).

binders.name: S
binders.type: Set ((n : ℕ) × Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n)

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg env P

binders.name: h'
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg env' P'

statement.conclusion:
InformationTheory.klDiv
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
      (MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O X Y)
        (MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0) M)
      P)
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
      (MeasureTheory.stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O' X' Y')
        (MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0) M)
      P') =
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range M,
    InformationTheory.klDiv
      ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history O X Y t)
            (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω})).compProd
        (stepKernel alg env t))
      ((MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history O X Y t)
            (P.restrict {ω | ↑t < MeasureTheory.hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω})).compProd
        (stepKernel alg env' t))

code:
/-- **Chain rule for histories stopped at a bounded stopping time.** For an algorithm `alg` run
against two environments `env`, `env'`, and a stopping rule `S` with stopping time `τ`, the
divergence between the laws of the histories stopped at `min τ M` is the sum over the rounds
`t < M` of the conditional divergences, on the event `{t < τ}`, of the step at round `t` given
the first `t` rounds (composition-product form). -/
lemma IsAlgEnvSeq.klDiv_map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_stepKernel (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg env P)
    (h' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg env' P') (hS : MeasurableSet S) (M : ℕ) :
    klDiv (P.map (stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O X Y) (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0) M))
        (P'.map (stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O' X' Y')
          (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0) M)) =
      ∑ t ∈ range M,
        klDiv ((P.restrict {ω | (t : WithTop ℕ) < hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω}).map
            (history O X Y t) ⊗ₘ stepKernel alg env t)
          ((P.restrict {ω | (t : WithTop ℕ) < hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω}).map
            (history O X Y t) ⊗ₘ stepKernel alg env' t)
proof:
:= by
  have hO := h.measurable_obs
  have hX := h.measurable_action
  have hY := h.measurable_feedback
  have hO' := h'.measurable_obs
  have hX' := h'.measurable_action
  have hY' := h'.measurable_feedback
  have hτm := measurable_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hO hX hY hS
  have hτm' := measurable_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hO' hX' hY' hS
  induction M with
  | zero =>
    rw [(hasLaw_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_zero P (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0)).map_eq,
      (hasLaw_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_zero P'
        (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0)).map_eq, klDiv_self, sum_range_zero]
  | succ M ih =>
    have hB : MeasurableSet {h : Σ n : ℕ, Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n | h.1 ≤ M} := measurableSet_sigma_fst_le M
    rw [sum_range_succ, ← ih, map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_succ_eq_add hO hX hY hτm (P := P) M,
      map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_succ_eq_add hO' hX' hY' hτm' (P := P') M,
      map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_eq_add hO hX hY hτm (P := P) M,
      map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_eq_add hO' hX' hY' hτm' (P := P') M,
      klDiv_add_add_of_measure_eq_zero hB
        (map_restrict_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_apply_compl_fst_le hO hX hY hτm _ M)
        (map_restrict_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_apply_compl_fst_le hO' hX' hY' hτm' _ M)
        (Measure.map_sigmaMk_succ_apply_fst_le _) (Measure.map_sigmaMk_succ_apply_fst_le _),
      klDiv_add_add_of_measure_eq_zero hS
        (map_restrict_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory_le_stoppedProcess_apply_compl hO hX hY hS M)
        (map_restrict_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory_le_stoppedProcess_apply_compl hO' hX' hY' hS M)
        (map_restrict_lt_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory_map_sigmaMk_apply hO hX hY hS M)
        (map_restrict_lt_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory_map_sigmaMk_apply hO' hX' hY' hS M),
      klDiv_map_measurableEmbedding _ _ (measurableEmbedding_sigma_mk (M + 1)),
      klDiv_map_measurableEmbedding _ _ (measurableEmbedding_sigma_mk M),
      map_history_succ_of_hasCondDistrib hO hX hY
        (h.hasCondDistrib_step_restrict_lt_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hS M),
      map_history_succ_of_hasCondDistrib hO' hX' hY'
        (h'.hasCondDistrib_step_restrict_lt_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hS M),
      klDiv_map_measurableEquiv, add_assoc]
    congr 1
    exact klDiv_compProd_eq_add _ _ _ _

code:
/-- **Chain rule for histories stopped at an almost surely finite stopping time.** For an
algorithm `alg` run against two environments `env`, `env'`, and a stopping rule `S` whose stopping
time is almost surely finite under both laws, the divergence between the laws of the stopped
histories is the series over the rounds `t` of the conditional divergences, on the event
`{t < τ}`, of the step at round `t` given the first `t` rounds (composition-product form). -/
lemma IsAlgEnvSeq.klDiv_map_stoppedValue_sigmaHistory_stepKernel (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg env P)
    (h' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg env' P') (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hτ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω ≠ ⊤)
    (hτ' : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P', hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0 ω ≠ ⊤) :
    klDiv (P.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O X Y) (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0)))
        (P'.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0))) =
      ∑' t : ℕ,
        klDiv ((P.restrict {ω | (t : WithTop ℕ) < hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω}).map
            (history O X Y t) ⊗ₘ stepKernel alg env t)
          ((P.restrict {ω | (t : WithTop ℕ) < hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0 ω}).map
            (history O X Y t) ⊗ₘ stepKernel alg env' t)
proof:
:= by
  have hO := h.measurable_obs
  have hX := h.measurable_action
  have hY := h.measurable_feedback
  have hO' := h'.measurable_obs
  have hX' := h'.measurable_action
  have hY' := h'.measurable_feedback
  have hτm := measurable_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hO hX hY hS
  have hτm' := measurable_hittingAfter_sigmaHistory hO' hX' hY' hS
  have hB : ∀ M, MeasurableSet {h : Σ n : ℕ, Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n | h.1 < M} :=
    measurableSet_sigma_fst_lt
  have hlaw : ∀ M, P.map (stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O X Y)
        (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0) M) =
      (P.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O X Y) (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0))).map
        (truncHist M) := fun M ↦
    ((hasLaw_map (measurable_stoppedValue_sigmaHistory hO hX hY hτm).aemeasurable)
      |>.stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory hτ M).map_eq
  have hlaw' : ∀ M, P'.map (stoppedProcess (sigmaHistory O' X' Y')
        (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0) M) =
      (P'.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0))).map
        (truncHist M) := fun M ↦
    ((hasLaw_map (measurable_stoppedValue_sigmaHistory hO' hX' hY' hτm').aemeasurable)
      |>.stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory hτ' M).map_eq
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_nat]
  simp_rw [← h.klDiv_map_stoppedProcess_sigmaHistory_stepKernel h' hS, hlaw, hlaw']
  set μ := P.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O X Y) (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O X Y) S 0)) with hμ
  set ν := P'.map (stoppedValue (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') (hittingAfter (sigmaHistory O' X' Y') S 0))
    with hν
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup_le fun M ↦ klDiv_map_le _ _ (measurable_truncHist M))
  rw [klDiv_eq_iSup_restrict hB (fun M N hMN h hh ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le hh hMN) (by
    ext h
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact ⟨h.1 + 1, h.1.lt_succ_self⟩)]
  refine iSup_mono fun M ↦ ?_
  calc klDiv (μ.restrict {h | h.1 < M}) (ν.restrict {h | h.1 < M})
      = klDiv ((μ.map (truncHist M)).restrict {h | h.1 < M})
          ((ν.map (truncHist M)).restrict {h | h.1 < M}) := by
        rw [restrict_map_truncHist, restrict_map_truncHist]
    _ ≤ klDiv (μ.map (truncHist M)) (ν.map (truncHist M)) := klDiv_restrict_le (hB M)

name: Learning.LinearBandit.klDiv_map_history_le_of_sq_le
doc:
The divergence between the laws of the histories of the first `n` rounds under two linear
Gaussian environments is at most `n C / 2` when `⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 ≤ C` on `𝒳`.

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P

binders.name: h'
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ') P'

binders.name: hC
binders.type: ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, inner ℝ x (θ - θ') ^ 2 ≤ C

statement.conclusion:
InformationTheory.klDiv (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history O X Y n) P)
    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history O' X' Y' n) P') ≤
  ENNReal.ofReal (↑n * (C / 2))

code:
/-- The divergence between the laws of the histories of the first `n` rounds under two linear
Gaussian environments is at most `n C / 2` when `⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 ≤ C` on `𝒳`. -/
lemma klDiv_map_history_le_of_sq_le (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P)
    (h' : IsAlgEnvSeq O' X' Y' alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ') P') {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, ⟪x, θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 ≤ C) (n : ℕ) :
    klDiv (P.map (history O X Y n)) (P'.map (history O' X' Y' n)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (n * (C / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [klDiv_map_history_of_sq_le h h' hC]
  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
  have hbound : ∀ t ∈ range n, ∫ ω, ⟪(X t ω : E), θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 / 2 ∂P ≤ C / 2 := by
    intro t _
    calc ∫ ω, ⟪(X t ω : E), θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 / 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ _, C / 2 ∂P :=
          integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ by positivity)
            (integrable_const _) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ by
              linarith [hC _ (X t ω).2])
      _ = C / 2 := by simp
  calc ∑ t ∈ range n, ∫ ω, ⟪(X t ω : E), θ - θ'⟫ ^ 2 / 2 ∂P
      ≤ ∑ _ ∈ range n, C / 2 := sum_le_sum hbound
    _ = n * (C / 2) := by simp

name: Learning.klDiv_compProd_compProd_compProd_prodMkLeft
doc:
The divergence of one step of an observation/policy/reward decomposition, in integral form:
the observation kernel `o` and the policy `π` are shared and the reward kernels `κ`, `η` (which
ignore the history and the observation) differ, so the divergence is the expected divergence of
the reward kernels at the played action, whose law is `π ∘ₘ (μ ⊗ₘ o)`.

statement.conclusion:
InformationTheory.klDiv
    (μ.compProd (o.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft (α × β) κ))))
    (μ.compProd (o.compProd (π.compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft (α × β) η)))) =
  ∫⁻ (b : γ), InformationTheory.klDiv (κ b) (η b) ∂(μ.compProd o).bind ⇑π

code:
/-- The divergence of one step of an observation/policy/reward decomposition, in integral form:
the observation kernel `o` and the policy `π` are shared and the reward kernels `κ`, `η` (which
ignore the history and the observation) differ, so the divergence is the expected divergence of
the reward kernels at the played action, whose law is `π ∘ₘ (μ ⊗ₘ o)`. -/
lemma klDiv_compProd_compProd_compProd_prodMkLeft
    [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated γ δ] (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (o : Kernel α β) [IsMarkovKernel o] (π : Kernel (α × β) γ) [IsMarkovKernel π] (κ η : Kernel γ δ)
    [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    klDiv (μ ⊗ₘ (o ⊗ₖ (π ⊗ₖ Kernel.prodMkLeft (α × β) κ)))
        (μ ⊗ₘ (o ⊗ₖ (π ⊗ₖ Kernel.prodMkLeft (α × β) η))) =
      ∫⁻ b, klDiv (κ b) (η b) ∂(π ∘ₘ (μ ⊗ₘ o))
